en_title: GTA 6 Shatters Streaming Records Before It Even Launches Globally
cn_title: 《GTA6》尚未在全球发售便打破直播纪录
opus_summary: 据StreamCharts统计，《GTA6》在新西兰发售后，截至当日12:30 UTC，在Twitch、YouTube和Kick的同时观看人数突破638万，接近此前纪录保持者《无畏契约》封闭测试的四倍。IGN为该游戏打出10分，称其在Metacritic的平均分为99分。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is already breaking records, despite not having even been out for a full day yet.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管《GTA6》发售还不到一整天，但它已经在打破纪录。

paragraphs.en: According to StreamCharts, GTA 6 shattered livestreaming viewership records following its release in New Zealand. Streamers began grinding the game at the earliest hours of the morning here in the United States thanks to handy loopholes on Xbox, allowing them to get a head start on things. As of 12:30 UTC today, the game crossed 6.38 million concurrent viewers across Twitch, YouTube, and Kick. This is nearly four times the previous record holder, which was Valorant's closed beta.
paragraphs.cn: 据StreamCharts称，《GTA6》在新西兰发售后打破了直播观看人数纪录。借助XBOX上的便利漏洞，主播们得以抢先一步，在美国当地的凌晨时分就开始苦玩这款游戏。截至今天协调世界时12:30，这款游戏在Twitch、YouTube和Kick上的同时观看人数超过638万。这一数字几乎是此前纪录保持者《无畏契约》封闭测试的四倍。

paragraphs.en: Twitch also provided first details about the game's performance using its own internal data to IGN.
paragraphs.cn: Twitch也利用自身内部数据，首次向IGN提供了这款游戏表现的详细信息。

paragraphs.en: Twitch recently revealed to IGN that GTA 5 has accumulated 9 billion hours watched over the course of its entire lifetime, making it an absolute juggernaut for the platform. It's one of the most-watched games and it's likely that GTA 6 will retain get at least one or two more big boosts in viewership. The game is rumored to come to PC early next year and its online mode is also expected sometime in 2027, both of which will likely be events in their own rights.
paragraphs.cn: Twitch最近向IGN透露，《GTA5》自推出以来累计观看时长已达90亿小时，使其成为该平台上绝对的巨头。它是观看人数最多的游戏之一，而《GTA6》的观看人数很可能还会至少迎来一两次大幅增长。据传这款游戏将于明年年初登陆PC，其线上模式预计也将在2027年的某个时候推出，这两件事本身都可能成为大事件。

paragraphs.en: IGN recently spoke with a number of content creators about how they're planning to handle GTA 6 and how long they think this game will remain relevant. Although some streamers believe this game will only be lucrative for a couple of weeks, others think there's potential for it to be mined for months and years to come. We'll have to wait and see how it shakes out.
paragraphs.cn: IGN最近与多位内容创作者聊了聊他们打算如何应对《GTA6》，以及他们认为这款游戏能够保持热度多久。虽然一些主播认为这款游戏只能带来几周的收益，但其他人认为，它在未来数月乃至数年都有被持续挖掘的潜力。结果如何，我们只能拭目以待。

paragraphs.en: IGN gave the game a 10/10 , noting that the game is simply unmatched in its depth, quality, and detail. The game is currently the highest-rated game in history on Metacritic with an unprecedented 99 average score.
paragraphs.cn: IGN给这款游戏打出了10/10分，指出它在深度、品质和细节方面都无与伦比。这款游戏目前以史无前例的99分平均分，成为Metacritic历史上评分最高的游戏。

paragraphs.en: "Exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played," reads an excerpt from our review.
paragraphs.cn: 我们的评测中写道：「《GTA6》细节精致，拥有无穷无尽的探索可能，制作上毫不妥协，是我玩过的最令人印象深刻的电子游戏。」

paragraphs.en: For more GTA 6, check out our breakdown of how long the game can be depending on how you play, how it performs on Xbox Series S , and much, much more.
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多《GTA6》的内容，请查看我们对不同玩法下游戏时长的分析、它在XBOX Series S上的表现，以及更多内容。
